name: Galactic War Progress
notes: If you are tracking any planets that were previously Invaded, roll 2D6 for each. Apply any accumulated "Making Ground" bonuses and world-trait modifiers with the Modifier field (the result is capped at 12).

rows.detail: The planet is lost to the invaders and cannot be visited again.
Add +1 to all future rolls on this table.
The planet can now be visited again. Due to increased troop presence, all future Invasion Threat rolls on this world are at -2.
